features.name: argument_compares_to_science_history_norms
features.definition: Does the original argument explicitly compare the OP's view or case to an established scientific or historical norm?
features.spec: Read only the argument column (OP's own text). Return 1 if the OP's own assertions explicitly compare their view, claim or situation to an established scientific norm/consensus/standard or an established historical norm/precedent (e.g., 'unlike the scientific consensus on X', 'as in historical practice of Y'). Return 0 if no such explicit comparison exists. A mere mention of science or history without comparison does not count. Quoted material counts only if the OP adopts it as their own comparison. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome updates or reports of the outcome as evidence. Missing or malformed argument: null.

h0: Mean delta does not differ by argument_compares_to_science_history_norms.
h1: Discussions with argument_compares_to_science_history_norms=1 have lower view change (delta) than those with 0.
note: Operational assumption: 'established norms' is judged by the annotator from the OP's text; no list of norms is supplied. Argument text is current text and may contain edits or outcome announcements, which the prompt excludes as evidence. Association only, not causal.
